subject: Quick switch-up for today's delivery
text: Hi there, hope I'm not catching you between grading sessions or anything! Anyway, I need to pull a tiny last-minute switcheroo on the delivery we lined up. The whole box of books, extra chairs, and the weird old lamp situation has gone sideways because my cousin's van threw a wobble and is now doing that clunk-clunk thing no one should ever hear twice. Basically, the driver who was supposed to swing by this afternoon won't make it until around seven, and even then he says it depends on whether he can find a quiet street to turn on. If that's too tight for your office schedule, totally fine, just yell and we'll shuffle things around. The good news is the heavy stuff already has wheels and I've got two hands plus one very determined neighbor who owes me snacks. Could you text or call before five so I know whether to redirect the truck, hold everything here, or drop it with the front desk like a mystery package? No stress on your side, but I'm trying to avoid showing up and awkwardly hovering. Appreciate you, professor, and sorry again for the scramble! I know these things happen, and I'm glad we caught it early rather than having half the department waiting for a chair. If the lamp needs to wait till tomorrow, no drama, just let me know soon enough that I can change the order without panicking. Sorry if the request is clunky, but time is being its usual bossy self!
